checks: Exact named tests in native-commands.json; paired source syntax
cost: of_word O(B) lowercase plus fixed-list comparisons. lit_bits O(B); perm_bits O(k), O(1) extra state. pos_bits requires n<usize::MAX; floating conversion/log rounding is retained. Dictionary and OnceLock state affect lemma_bits.
description: of_word selects first true predicate: punctuation, lowercased NEG membership, numeric/QUANT, modal/auxiliary, function tag/relation, else Dropped. of_tag_change uses verb pair then same-properness noun pair then coarse equality. Literal bits sum 8 times UTF-8 widths except Hebrew scalars count one.

inverse: For observed class c, compatible (tag,rel,lemma) are the predicate c intersected with failures of all earlier predicates. Countless lemmas share a class; costs also identify fibers, not unique strings.
On admitted inputs, punctuation cannot yield Neg even for lemma not; no output class is sampled randomly. Costs do not compress or persist text.
limitations: No annotator/model loading, live corpus, full suite, teacher, GPU or persistent-learning evidence. No executable percentage surrogate: categorical codecs/effects need a useful metric before future caps 1/2/5/10%.
